meta.truth_definition: truth(age) = 'erratic' if turned_erratic_at is not null and age >= turned_erratic_at, else manifest pattern (packet reference code)
meta.time_unit: storm age in real seconds (0..480); official advisories at ages 30,90,...,450

likelihood_tables.note: P(said | current truth). Errors are uniform over the 5 wrong outlooks and i.i.d. across messages given truth (binomial and Markov tests pass), so a naive-Bayes product over messages is exact under this model.
likelihood_tables.simple_update: log post(c) = log prior_t(c) + sum_official log_lik.official[c][said] + sum_wire log_lik.wire[c][said]; for the erratic transition use the 11-state filter in posterior.py (states base x turned + erratic-from-formation)

hurricane_conditions.target: impact message for that island at an age > advisory age, among islands with no impact yet
hurricane_conditions.recommendation: use the published probability as-is (recalibration does not improve holdout Brier)

cone.usage: spread ~= RMS radial error; per-axis sigma ~= spread/sqrt(2); add erratic risk separately

corrections.engine_gap_bug: posterior.py _pt() cannot recover ages = 2 mod 4 (e.g. 90) from track points; after a feed gap covering ages ~82-98 or a late (re)start the track score is silently off for the rest of the storm. Use verify-sources/posterior_patched.py (linear interpolation between track points). Holdout: 20-s gap at ages 80-100 -> mean log-loss 0.2184 unpatched vs 0.1587 patched; bot started at age 200 -> 0.1044 vs 0.0414 over ages 200-480 (no-gap reference 0.0323).
corrections.recent_turn_floor: classifier.recent_turn_floor_s = 20: reserve eps = 1-exp(-lambda*20) = 0.0027 for 'turned erratic in the last 20 s but not visible'. D chosen on train rows (10-20 s best); holdout mean log-loss 0.1501 -> 0.1489, accuracy unchanged. Unfloored, rows with max p >= 0.999 claim 0.99965 but are right 0.99743 (holdout).

verification.optional_live_refit_note: source-model numbers refitted on all 600 seasons for use in the live season after validation; NOT used to compute any holdout metric. The densities/weights in 'classifier' remain the train-only (seasons 1-400) fit.
